page: Microsoft Azure L32s_v3 is an x86_64 storage-optimized virtual machine built on dedicated Intel Xeon 8370C hardware running at a base clock of 2.8 GHz. The instance configuration allocates 32 virtual CPUs derived from 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, supported by 48 MB of L3 cache. Compute instructions benefit from vector acceleration extensions, including AVX-512 and AVX512_VNNI, enabling efficient vectorized operations and integer dot-product processing.

System memory consists of 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a substantial 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. High-speed local persistence is supplied directly via 8024 GB of bundled NVMe SSD storage. Benchmark telemetry reflects strong memory subsystem performance, achieving a PassMark memory score of 2,845.43 (top 25%) and an uncached large-block read throughput of 149.6 GB/sec. The bundled storage and memory architecture supports high data throughput for local read-write operations without incurring external disk network latency.

Across compute benchmarks, the instance delivers steady mid-tier multi-threaded results, recording a multi-core Geekbench score of 14,250.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 37,006.88. In-memory operations demonstrate stable performance, reaching 31.46 million Redis SET operations per second and completing clang compilation tests with a score of 26,825.0. While smaller 135M parameter language model execution remains strong at 292.02 tokens per second, large model execution (such as 70B models) shows significant performance degradation due to the absence of dedicated GPU acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the bundled 8 TB NVMe array provides significant density for local I/O workloads compared to attaching equivalent external block volumes. Because local storage is ephemeral, the instance is engineered specifically for workloads with built-in data replication, including distributed NoSQL databases, transactional data stores, search indexing engines, and large-scale data warehousing nodes.
description: Microsoft Azure L32s_v3 is a storage-optimized instance powered by a 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon 8370C processor across 32 vCPUs and 16 physical cores. Configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, the instance delivers a generous 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio alongside 8,024 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage. Performance metrics show robust memory bandwidth, highlighted by a top-quartile PassMark memory score of 2,845.43 and 31.46 million Redis SET operations per second. CPU evaluations reveal stable mid-range compute capabilities, evidenced by a multi-core Geekbench score of 14,250.0 and PassMark CPU score of 37,006.88. Without GPU acceleration, the platform is ill-suited for large-scale AI inference, but its dense internal NVMe storage offers substantial hardware efficiency for high-IOPS applications. It is well-fitted for distributed NoSQL databases, transactional systems, search indexes, and large local cache nodes.
